title: Some keys remapped with Keyboard Manager have arbitraily reverted to standard mapping. I've double checked the Edit tool and the program "knows" what I want, but some keys have reverted anyway. This never used to happen with the eold Editor.
author: marklaporta1

inferences: The editor state and runtime behavior may be diverging, but the public report does not show whether the failure is tied to specific keys, a target application, or an elevation boundary.

The targeted information request is cheaper and more honest than a speculative fix plan.

comment.body:
Thanks for calling out that Keyboard Manager still shows the mappings you configured even when some keys fall back to their normal behavior.

To narrow whether this is a specific remap definition, an app/elevation boundary, or the runtime hook losing state, please provide:
1. A screenshot of the affected Keyboard Manager entries, plus one exact source key and expected target for each remap that is failing.
2. Whether the same remap fails in Notepad, and whether PowerToys or the target application is running elevated when it fails.
3. When it first started happening (for example after reboot, sleep, a PowerToys update, or a Windows update) and whether restarting PowerToys temporarily restores the remap.
4. A fresh diagnostic ZIP captured immediately after reproducing the problem by posting a comment that contains `/bugreport`.

Those details will separate a specific remap-definition bug from a broader hook or application-targeting problem.
